description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Edea
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Ice Strike (0~2), removed after using Apex Ice Strike two times

description.name: Apex Ice Strike Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Ice Strike level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Ice abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Edea]

description.name: Apex Ice Strike Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Ice Strike level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Edea]
